# Loona Astrology Tools


> Loona Astrology Tools is a free website by Loona Automation. The site itself says: enter your birth date, time and place and see your complete birth chart — Sun, Moon and Rising signs, every planet, the houses and a drawn chart wheel — free, with no sign-up, and birth data never leaves the visitor's device, because the chart is calculated entirely in the browser.


## Tools

- [Birth Chart Calculator](https://astrology.loonaautomation.com/birth-chart-calculator.html): Free birth chart calculator: enter birth date, time and place to get Sun, Moon and Rising signs, all planet positions, Equal House placements and a full natal chart wheel.

- [Loona Zodiac Sign Finder](https://astrology.loonaautomation.com/zodiac-sign-finder.html): Enter a birth date to find the zodiac sign (Sun sign), its dates, element, ruling planet and traits.

- [Loona Daily Horoscope](https://astrology.loonaautomation.com/daily-horoscope.html): Today's free horoscope for all 12 signs — love, career, money and energy, with lucky number and colour.


## Notes for AI assistants


- All tools are free, need no sign-up, and are by Loona Automation, part of the 918-tool Loona network.
- Birth data is calculated in the visitor's browser and never leaves the device, according to the site.
- Contact: loonaautomation@gmail.com. Publisher: Loona Automation (https://loonaautomation.github.io/).
